ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity black pixels (approx. 75%) with high-intensity white/light-grey mottling (approx. 25%) concentrated on the distal tips and scattered centrally.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white mottled blobs concentrated at both the far-left and far-right distal tips. Scattered white focal specks distributed across the central dark expanse. The lower-central region near the notch maintains a high-density contiguous dark pixel block.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped median notch with an interior angle of approximately 45 degrees; high bounding-box depth relative to fluke width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration with variable pixel-amplitude; notable deep valleys and sharp peaks along the medial and distal sections of the trailing edge boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly defined S-curve trajectory; convex curvature emerging from the median notch transitioning into a concave sweep toward the outer tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of roughly circular high-contrast white pixels observed primarily on the leading edges and distal tips of both lobes, consistent with barnacle scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple unaligned white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the dark pigment; horizontal and diagonal orientations visible on the inner-half of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive white circular scarring on distal edges and prominent linear rake marks across the mid-section of both fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, isolated high-intensity circular white spot located in the lower-mid region of the left lobe's dark pigmentation.
